title: Hurt Tint
description: Customizable colored vignette on damage with adjustable color, thickness, and opacity.
body:
Hurt Tint – Custom Damage Vignette

Hurt Tint adds a colored vignette at the edges of the screen whenever your player takes damage. The vignette appears on top of Minecraft's default hurt effect, giving you a clear and customizable visual cue that fits your personal style.

✨ Features

Adjustable color – RGB sliders for any vignette tint (red, blue, green, etc.).

Thickness control – from barely visible to a wide border.

Brightness control – set the vignette's starting opacity from subtle to intense.

Smooth fade – appears instantly on damage and fades out over 2 seconds.

🎮 How to configure

Open the Mods menu → select Hurt Tint.

Click the Config button.

Adjust the Red, Green, Blue, Thickness, and Max Opacity sliders — changes take effect immediately.

Press «Done» — your settings are saved for the next session.

You can also edit config/hurt_tint-client.toml manually.
